jp-operators-p6-npg-kushiro-dc-release-2.summary: Joint release of Getworks, Tokyo Gas Engineering Solutions (TGES) and Nippon Paper, dated 5 November 2026 on Nippon Paper's newsroom. The three companies have signed contracts on land use and power supply to carry out a container data-centre business at Nippon Paper's Kushiro works (日本製紙釧路事業所). Getworks is the data-centre operator and plans, designs, builds and operates the container data centre; TGES coordinates the business and designs and builds the foundations, water supply and electrical works; Nippon Paper provides the land (釧路事業所用地) and supplies power from the existing receiving and generating plant at the works. The companies plan 6 MW in operation within FY2026 and expansion to about 40 MW in September 2027, and regard the site as having potential for up to 150 MW, with gas-fired distributed generation under consideration. Nippon Paper notes that the Kushiro works ended paper production in 2021 and continues its power-generation business. The operating dates and capacities are plans, not observations.
